description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale, Ali Demi! The apartment is located near the 1 Maji School in a building from 2005, it is located on the third residential floor. It has a net area of ​​102m2, it is organized in a living room with a kitchen, two bedrooms, a distribution corridor, two toilets and two balconies.
